mainEntity.name: Should I buy an AI lead-generation platform or build a workflow myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right choice depends on whether you need research, enrichment, scoring, messaging, follow-up, or all four. A simple workflow may be enough if you already have a CRM and only need organized research; a broader system may help when repeated tasks span prospecting, email drafts, content, and follow-up. Compare data sources, export options, review controls, integration requirements, and total operating cost rather than counting features. Ask whether the system can show why a prospect was included and allow you to correct errors. Run My AI Biz emphasizes task-specific assistants and coordinated workflows, so begin with one assistant before combining several.
acceptedAnswer.description: Buy a platform when you need packaged data, integrations, and support. Build a workflow when your process is unusual or you want more control over prompts and review steps. Compare data quality, permissions, exports, costs, and human-approval features before deciding.
